setup.text: Smoke drifts from the forge where the fire has gone sullen. Ilsa works the bellows alone, her rhythm steady and practiced. "You're on the bellows."

option_a.text: Ilsa accepts the bundle of sticks without pausing.

option_b.text: The player casts *ignite* on the banked coals, sending a flare through the forge. Ilsa's hands tighten on the bellows handle as the heat shifts through the metal, her rhythm falling into steady alignment with the new flame.

option_c.text:
The player watches the smoke curl from the coals. "Rough morning for it."

Ilsa keeps her rhythm against the bellows. "It'll come round."
